# Emma Global

> Emma Global delivers integrated solutions across workforce management, administration, ESG, and digital innovation — helping businesses scale efficiently and sustainably.

Emma Global is an integrated business services firm operating from four regional hubs —
Delhi (South Asia), Singapore (Asia-Pacific), United Kingdom (UK and Europe), Dubai (Middle East and Africa) — covering 30 markets.
Rather than supplying one function, it runs workforce, administration, sustainability and
digital work under a single accountable relationship.

Office: 12-B North Parade, Mollison Way, Edgware, Harrow, Middlesex, HA8 5QH. Contact: Puwar.R@emma-global.com, patel.a@emma-global.com.

## Services

- [Human Resources (HR Solutions)](https://emma-global.com/services/hr-solutions): Comprehensive talent acquisition and workforce management solutions across skilled and professional roles, tailored to meet your business needs.
- [Administration Services](https://emma-global.com/services/administration-services): Streamlined administrative and operational support to enhance efficiency, ensure compliance, and improve day-to-day business performance.
- [Digital & AI Solutions](https://emma-global.com/services/digital-ai-solutions): Leveraging technology, automation, and AI-driven insights to optimize processes and accelerate digital transformation.
